s: a tiny, tree-shaded square in the Old Town, easy to miss and easy to love
w: One of Gamla Stan's smallest and quietest squares, named for a fire ("brända" -- burnt) that cleared the plot after the medieval blaze of 1330. A single large chestnut tree now shades a handful of benches wedged between the surrounding buildings -- a pocket of stillness a few steps off the tourist routes through the Old Town.
_facts: Small square in Gamla Stan (Stockholm's Old Town)
Name means "the burnt plot", after a 1330 fire that cleared the site and left it undeveloped
Shaded by a single large chestnut tree
One of the smallest public squares in central Stockholm
